culpritSource.quote: The culprit is Kaede Yashiro. Her motive was that she had written her very own movie script that she poured her heart and soul into. When many others read her script there were no doubts that her script would make an amazing movie. However, this would be proven false as her movie was directed by Teruomi who ruined her movie by casting his wife Mowako as the lead instead of having a pro do the acting.
